description: An interdisciplinary team of university engineers about to graduate: five systems engineers and one statistician from Escuela Colombiana de Ingeniería Julio Garavito University and Pontificia Universidad Javeriana (Colombia). We turn raw data into clear, working products, blending full-stack, cloud, AI and rigorous statistics. Global top-45 finalists in 2025, we're back for more. Fast communicators, early shippers, fans of hard problems.
